summary: The filing is an 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) reporting a letter to shareholders describing a business pivot: urban-gro combined with Flash Sports Media and integrated IPG to focus on cricket media. No specific deal terms (price, premium, dates) are disclosed. The board does not provide a recommendation or name advisors. The filing is a voluntary update on strategy, not a triggering event under special situations categories—a routine current report on other events and exhibits.
